Oh, how nice it would be now, to have coffee with you now!! Or simply to be at home and work yesterday, it helped a lot; friends have to take care of the obstacles - That's the only entertainment when you say feminine verpil one has here. You, she has had to examine me since yesterday afternoon, and now she has done it - But it's not strange to me, I prefer it this way, otherwise I feel comfortable - Unfortunately, unfortunately, I still have your pain - I'm sorry that this justice won't last too long with one m [illegible] Bob should bring Mom's white suitcase to take back most of the things I took with me - (children's watch, building blocks, clothes, etc.) It's really a shame to leave everything there in the suitcase. The food could be eaten if it were served appetizingly. I always have to think of you, Bobden, when you came to the military. It was so much worse, and you were so much more patient. I have to get used to it too. So, I hope you'll be living with me on Thursday, darling, then we'll take care of each other. Take good care of yourselves, and see you soon, children! And make sure we're with you. Lots of love from your [illegible] Baba
